Inter Miami Loses Leagues Cup Match

Inter Miami lost a Leagues Cup match 2-1 to Monterrey. The match was notable for the absence of Messi, whose father had passed away. Diego Rossi scored a late winner for Monterrey. The match was part of the Leagues Cup. Inter Miami was without their key player Messi due to personal reasons. Monterrey's win was secured with a 2-1 scoreline.
